abilities.name: Valiant Strike
abilities.description: A swift melee strike on a single enemy. Deals 80% weapon damage with 10% chance inflict Vulnerable to the target.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc, striking all enemies in front for 50% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Bloodblade
abilities.description: Pierce one enemy for 50% weapon damage and inflict Bleeding, which deals 250% weapon damage over 5s.

abilities.name: Steady Blow
abilities.description: Strike one enemy for 60% weapon damage and steel yourself, gaining a stack of Bulwark.

abilities.name: Flame Strike
abilities.description: Channel flame into a devastating single-target blow, dealing 250% weapon damage as Fire Damage.

abilities.name: Half Moon Slash
abilities.description: Hurl a crescent blade that pierces every enemy in its path, dealing 150% weapon damage to each.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Spin towards enemies and attack surrounding enemies for 100% weapon damage rapidly.

abilities.name: Rending Onslaught
abilities.description: Carve 3 savage cuts across nearby enemies, each dealing 100% weapon damage and inflicting Bleeding, which deals 250% weapon damage over 5s.

abilities.name: Rage Shout
abilities.description: Increase 25% attack speed for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Rage Shield
abilities.description: Surround yourself with a barrier of rage that absorbs up to 40% of your Max HP in damage, lasting 8s.

abilities.name: Deadly Hook
abilities.description: Hurl a hook that pierces every enemy in its path, dealing 75% weapon damage, then reels them back to you and leaves them Vulnerable.

abilities.name: Earthstrike
abilities.description: Smash the ground with a deafening crack, tearing a shockwave through the ground ahead of you. Deals 300% weapon damage to every enemy in its path and stuns them.

abilities.name: Iron Thorn
abilities.description: Clad yourself in iron spikes for 8s. Thorns is increased by 100%, and every second you lash out at enemies around you for 100% of your Thorns as physical damage.

abilities.name: Molten Might
abilities.description: Stoke the forge within: instantly recover 40% of your Max Mana, then for 8s your Strong Attack damage is increased by 25% and abilities cost 35% less Mana.

abilities.name: Fire Ball
abilities.description: Conjure a homing fireball that explodes on impact, dealing 75% weapon damage to all enemies in a small area.

abilities.name: Ice Shards
abilities.description: Hurl an icy shard that strikes a single enemy for 90% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Electrocute
abilities.description: Unleash a fan of crackling lightning that strikes every enemy in front for 70% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Flame Lightning
abilities.description: Call down a bolt of flame and lightning on a random enemy, dealing 50% weapon damage as Fire and 50% weapon damage as Lightning.

abilities.name: Flame Breath
abilities.description: Unleash a stream of roaring flame in a line, dealing 180% weapon damage to enemies in its path and setting them Burning.

abilities.name: Ice Meteor
abilities.description: Call down a frozen meteor that leaves a chilling field for 3 seconds, dealing 65% weapon damage per tick and chilling enemies caught inside.

abilities.name: Lightning Storm
abilities.description: Conjure a storm of lightning that strikes 3 random enemies, dealing 150% weapon damage to each.

abilities.name: Frost Beam
abilities.description: Channel a beam of frost for 3 seconds, striking every enemy in its path for 60% weapon damage each tick.

abilities.name: Ice Nova
abilities.description: Release a nova of frost around you, dealing 30% weapon damage to nearby enemies and freezing them solid.

abilities.name: Fire Elemental
abilities.description: Summon a fire elemental that shoots fireballs at an enemy for 80% of your weapon damage.

abilities.name: Ice Block
abilities.description: Encase yourself in ice for 4s, unable to act but immune to all damage. The ice then shatters, dealing Cold damage to all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Fire Meteor
abilities.description: Call down a blazing meteor that erupts on impact, dealing 400% weapon damage to all enemies in the blast and setting them Burning.

abilities.name: Flame Aura
abilities.description: Wreathe yourself in flame for 5s, gaining 10% critical hit chance and 50% critical hit damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Cloud
abilities.description: Summon a storm cloud over the target that calls down 8 lightning bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 50% weapon damage to nearby enemies with a 20% chance to inflict Short Stun.

abilities.name: Poison Shot
abilities.description: Fire a poisoned arrow that deals 100% weapon damage as Poison damage, with a 20% chance to inflict Poisoned.

abilities.name: Arcane Bomb
abilities.description: Launch a homing arcane charge that detonates on impact, dealing 70% weapon damage as Arcane damage to all enemies caught in the blast.

abilities.name: Knife Barrage
abilities.description: Hurl a flurry of throwing knives at up to three nearby enemies in quick succession, each knife dealing 90% weapon damage as Physical damage.

abilities.name: Twin Arrows
abilities.description: Fire two arrows in quick succession at up to two nearby enemies, each dealing 70% weapon damage as Physical damage. If only one enemy is available, both arrows strike it.

abilities.name: Steady Shot
abilities.description: Loose a powerful arrow that pierces every enemy in its path, dealing 250% weapon damage as Physical damage.

abilities.name: Multishot
abilities.description: Loose a storm of arrows in a wide cone, striking every enemy caught in it for 200% weapon damage as Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: Plant your feet and pour a stream of arrows into your target for 2 seconds, each arrow dealing 35% weapon damage as Physical damage.

abilities.name: Venom Bolt
abilities.description: Fire a powerful poisoned projectile that bursts on impact, dealing 120% weapon damage as Poison damage to all nearby enemies and inflicting Poisoned.

abilities.name: Poison Trap
abilities.description: Set a trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing 200% weapon damage as Poison damage to everything nearby with a 100% chance to inflict 2 stacks of Poisoned.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: Fire a concussive shot that erupts into a shockwave, dealing 100% weapon damage as Physical damage to all enemies in front of you, knocking them back with a 100% chance to inflict Short Stun.

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.description: Fire a flare that bursts on impact, inflicting Vulnerable and Dizzy on all nearby enemies for 3s.
abilities.cooldown: 30 s at level 1, 25.5 s at level 10

abilities.name: Arcane Arrowstorm
abilities.description: Call down a rain of arcane arrows that repeatedly deals 160% weapon damage as Arcane damage to enemies caught beneath it.

abilities.name: Phantom Form
abilities.description: Take on a phantom form for 5s, gaining 15% Dodge Chance and 50% Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Frost Trap
abilities.description: Set a trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing 300% weapon damage as Cold damage to everything nearby with a 100% chance to inflict Deep Freeze.

abilities.name: Threefold Strike
abilities.description: Strike a single enemy for 85% weapon damage. Every third blow flows into an empowered finisher, dealing 200% weapon damage to the target.

abilities.name: Furious Fist
abilities.description: Unleash a furious fist at one enemy for 75% weapon damage, building momentum - each strike grants +5% Attack Speed (up to 20 stacks) for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Seismic Strike
abilities.description: Attack a single target with your weapon. Every 3rd attack strikes heavily and unleashes a shockwave, dealing area damage. Deals 85% weapon damage to the target; the 3rd strike deals an additional 100% weapon damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Chi Bolt
abilities.description: Hurl a bolt of focused chi at a single enemy for 85% weapon damage. Every third bolt also restores 5% of your Max Health when it hits.

abilities.name: Sacred Judgment
abilities.description: Whirl and bring down a weapon strike crackling with holy lightning, dealing 400% weapon damage as Lightning to the target and 100% weapon damage as Lightning to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Piercing Lunge
abilities.description: Lunge forward with a piercing thrust, skewering every enemy along its path for 200% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Whirlwind Staff
abilities.description: Conjure two tornados before you that wander toward enemies, dealing 70% weapon damage to any enemy caught inside.

abilities.name: Golden Palms
abilities.description: Thrust both palms forward, conjuring two golden hands that sweep every enemy in a wide arc before you for 160% weapon damage and drive them back.

abilities.name: Sacred Orbs
abilities.description: Conjure a sacred orb that circles you, striking each enemy it passes through for 86.5% weapon damage as Lightning damage.

abilities.name: Spirit Stream
abilities.description: Channel a stream of spirit through your body, healing 11% of your Max Health every second for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge the target, then slam every enemy around you for 180% weapon damage and stun them for 2s.

abilities.name: Spirit Twin
abilities.description: Summon a spirit twin at your side for 8s. It mirrors your Basic and Strong attacks, striking the enemies you strike.

abilities.name: Wind Steps
abilities.description: Ride the wind for 4s, gaining 30% Dodge Chance.

abilities.name: Divine Thunder
abilities.description: Stand fast and call down holy lightning, each pulse striking nearby enemies for 280% weapon damage and leaving them Dazed for 5s.
